teklametraj.title: TeklaMetraj — Steel Takeoff Tool
teklametraj.description: Extracts steel profile and plate quantities from a Tekla Structures model into an Excel sheet — the tool we use on our own projects.
teklametraj.name: TeklaMetraj
teklametraj.lead: Reads every steel part in a Tekla Structures model and produces profile, plate and bolt/nut takeoffs as Excel tables. The ticks next to each row apply instantly: reclassify a profile as a plate or remove it from the takeoff — tables and all totals update immediately, and the Excel file is written with one click.
teklametraj.f1: Finds the installed Tekla Structures version (2023, 2025, 2026) automatically from the registry; reads only the selected parts when there is a selection, otherwise all steel parts
teklametraj.f2: Bar count is calculated from stock bar length: 12 m for profiles; 6 m for box, tube and angle sections; 1 m for round/rebar (D16) profiles
teklametraj.f3: Non-standard angles (L sections outside the EN 10056 list) are automatically moved to the plate takeoff
teklametraj.f4: Plates are grouped by thickness; the number of 1.5 × 6 m stock sheets required and the total weight are calculated
teklametraj.f5: Bolts and nuts are collected in a separate table with diameter, standard, type and length
teklametraj.f6: Paint quantity uses the real consumption formula: DFT, volume solids, density and loss factor are adjustable in the UI
teklametraj.f7: Also runs inside Tekla: it is listed in the "Applications & components" catalog with its own icon — no separate program to launch
teklametraj.f8: Marks apply instantly: a profile marked as plate moves to the plate table, a row marked "Exclude?" is removed from the list; dedicated lists let you undo a mistaken mark
teklametraj.how2: The installer locates Tekla's installation folder itself and places the program into the extensions folder
teklametraj.how3: Open Tekla, load your model, then run TeklaMetraj standalone or from the "Applications & components" catalog
teklametraj.reqValue: Windows 10 / 11 (64-bit) — works with Tekla Structures 2021 and later (tested on 2023 / 2026). No separate .NET install needed.
teklametraj.manual: The installer adds the Start menu shortcut, the user guide and the icon for the Tekla catalog.
teklametraj.verified: The takeoff engine is verified by 43 automated tests.
teklametraj.note: This is an engineering takeoff tool; final responsibility for quantities rests with the user.

software.title: Our Engineering Software
software.description: We share the in-house engineering tools we develop and use in our daily workflow, free of charge.
software.name: Composite Beam Design
software.lead: A desktop application that designs composite steel-concrete beams on ribbed (trapezoidal decking) floors to TS EN 1994-1-1 (Eurocode 4) with the Turkish National Annex. It computes the design forces itself, tries every IPE/HEA section to find the lightest solution and produces a colour Word report.
software.f1: Dead loads are computed automatically (steel + concrete + decking); you only enter the extra dead and live loads
software.f2: 37 IPE/HEA sections are checked and the lightest passing section is selected
software.f3: Rib spacing optimisation: the solution using the least steel per m² of floor
software.f4: Decking check: bending, web crushing and deflection
software.f5: You enter the stud diameter; the length and the number are calculated automatically
software.f6: Colour, tabular Word (RTF) report and a calculation engine cross-checked against hand calculations
software.how2: Extract the zip into a folder
software.manual: The package includes a 625-line user manual.
software.verified: Calculation engine verified by 102 automated tests.
software.note: An engineering calculation tool; final design responsibility remains with the user engineer.
